Description: Single-AZ private egress network with explicit CIDRs and AZ; NAT Gateway hourly/data processing and public IPv4 charges continue while the separate host is stopped, and deleting this stack leaves the host's separately retained data volume intact.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: public subnet -> one NAT Gateway -> private subnet; host lives in a separate stack
must: Select one AZ for this network and the intended host.
Supply RFC1918 CIDRs; keep both subnet ranges inside the VPC range and non-overlapping.
Review NAT Gateway hourly/data processing and public IPv4 charges; they continue while the host is stopped.
This stack owns network resources only; it must not own or delete the separately managed host or retained data volume.

VpcCidr.ConstraintDescription: Enter a valid RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix from /16 through /28.
VpcCidr.Description: Explicit private VPC CIDR; must contain both non-overlapping subnet CIDRs.

PublicSubnetCidr.ConstraintDescription: Enter a valid RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix from /16 through /28.
PublicSubnetCidr.Description: Explicit public subnet CIDR within VpcCidr and non-overlapping with PrivateSubnetCidr. The subnet does not auto-assign public IPs.

PrivateSubnetCidr.ConstraintDescription: Enter a valid RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix from /16 through /28.
PrivateSubnetCidr.Description: Explicit private subnet CIDR within VpcCidr and non-overlapping with PublicSubnetCidr. The subnet does not auto-assign public IPs.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Explicit operator-selected AZ. Both subnets and the NAT Gateway use this same AZ.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Isolates the separately managed host and gives the public/private subnet pair one explicit IPv4 boundary.
must: Use an RFC1918 CIDR that contains both subnet CIDRs.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Places only the NAT Gateway on the internet-routed side; public address assignment stays disabled.
must: Stay in AvailabilityZone and do not auto-assign public IPv4 addresses.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Hosts the private workload subnet; outbound internet uses the single NAT Gateway.
must: Stay in AvailabilityZone and do not auto-assign public IPv4 addresses.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Provides the internet edge required by the public NAT Gateway subnet.
Connects the VPC to its sole Internet Gateway.
must: Keep the attachment in place for the public route and NAT egress path.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Holds the public subnet's route to the Internet Gateway for NAT traffic.
Keeps private subnet internet egress on the NAT Gateway path.
Provides the NAT Gateway's public subnet with its IPv4 internet path.
must: Route through this VPC's Internet Gateway.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Sends private subnet IPv4 egress through the single public NAT Gateway.
must: Do not add a direct Internet Gateway route to the private subnet.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Activates the public IPv4 route for the NAT Gateway subnet.
Activates NAT-only IPv4 egress for the private workload subnet.
Supplies the NAT Gateway's stable public IPv4 address; the address is metered independently of host runtime.
Gives the private subnet outbound internet access through one public, single-AZ gateway.
must: Stay in PublicSubnet and AvailabilityZone; hourly and data processing charges continue while the host is stopped.

VpcId.Description: VPC ID for the separately managed private host stack.

PrivateSubnetId.Description: Private subnet ID for the separately managed host stack.

PublicSubnetId.Description: Public subnet ID that contains the NAT Gateway.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Selected AZ shared by both subnets and the NAT Gateway.
